top_paper.title: Sage-A1.5: From Long-Horizon Execution to Scientific Exploration with Capability Composition
top_paper.summary: Sage-A1.5 is a 35B mixture-of-experts agentic model that improves long-horizon problem solving via adaptive task delegation, verification, and open scientific exploration.

papers.title: Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience
papers.summary: Ropedia W0 is a world foundation model for cross-embodiment loco-manipulation that unifies human and robot data via kinematic representations and achieves state-of-the-art results across diverse benchmarks.

papers.title: Large Flow Language Models
papers.summary: A large-scale continuous flow language model achieves efficient training, high-quality generation, and faster inference through blockwise flow design, self-speculative decoding, and multi-token prediction.

papers.title: Matrix-Game 4.0: Harnessing Video Models for Real-Time Playable Game Worlds
papers.summary: Matrix-Game 4.0 separates game logic from visual synthesis via an executable engine and autoregressive video renderer, achieving real-time interactive gameplay with low latency.

papers.title: Correction Training for Diffusion Models
papers.summary: A correction module trained to refine diffusion predictions reduces exposure bias, improving unguided sample quality and enabling distillation to eliminate inference overhead.

papers.title: SWIFT: Self-guided Weak-to-strong dIFfusion models via Target extrapolation
papers.summary: Swift improves diffusion model training by extrapolating regression targets away from a frozen weak denoiser, reducing error and training cost without inference overhead.

papers.title: From Short Clips to Real-Time Streams: Identity-Aware Supervision and Context-Efficient Generation for Video Face Swapping
papers.summary: StreamingSwap is a real-time flow-matching framework for video face swapping that improves identity fidelity and efficiency via joint identity-reconstruction loss and reduced spatial-temporal generation, achieving stable 20 FPS performance on long videos.

papers.title: VLA-Rolling: Fewer Denoising Steps, Better Control via Adaptive Action Reuse
papers.summary: VLA-Rolling improves vision-language-action model efficiency by reusing discarded action tails with adaptive denoising budgets, reducing inference cost and boosting success rates.

papers.title: EdgeKernelBench: Unified LLM-Driven Kernel Generation for Edge Backends
papers.summary: EdgeKernelBench and LEKA enable unified evaluation and layered optimization of LLM-generated kernels across heterogeneous edge backends, revealing a gap between correctness and performance.

papers.title: HybridResearcher: Bridging the Structured-Unstructured Boundary for Deep Research Agents
papers.summary: HybridResearcher is a small agent trained via synthetic cross-source trajectories and reinforcement learning to reason across structured and unstructured data, outperforming much larger models without forgetting single-source skills.

papers.title: HumanSkill-4D: Training-Free Language Querying of Animatable Gaussian Avatars in Space and Time
papers.summary: HumanSkill-4D enables language-driven selection of avatar regions and motion intervals via shared multimodal reasoning and geometric operators without training.

papers.title: Sage-A1.5: From Long-Horizon Execution to Scientific Exploration with Capability Composition
papers.summary: Sage-A1.5 is a 35B mixture-of-experts agentic model that improves long-horizon problem solving via adaptive task delegation, verification, and open scientific exploration.

papers.title: SolarRenderer: Few-Step Generative Reference Rendering
papers.summary: SolarRenderer adapts a frozen video backbone with lightweight LoRAs to render realistic videos from diverse structural inputs in four steps or real-time streaming, using frame-aligned training data.

papers.title: Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents
papers.summary: FocusGUI is a lightweight adapter that dynamically selects relevant multimodal evidence for GUI agents to prevent compounding errors from irrelevant context, improving action accuracy without fine-tuning the backbone.

papers.title: PhysSkin++: Real-Time and Generalizable Physics-Based Animation via Self-Supervised Neural Skinning
papers.summary: PhysSkin++ learns continuous neural skinning fields from static shapes to enable real-time, physics-based animation across diverse geometries and spatial representations without per-object training.

papers.title: EMBER: Predicting TCR--pMHC Binding Without a Docked Complex
papers.summary: EMBER predicts TCR-pMHC binding from independently folded monomers using SE(3)-invariant graphs, avoiding docking errors and reducing computation while improving accuracy across folding tools.

papers.title: MMEnterprise-Bench: Evaluating Enterprise Agents over Evolving Multimodal Records
papers.summary: MMEnterprise-Bench evaluates multimodal agents on reasoning over evolving workplace records with conflicts and missing evidence.

papers.title: TRACE: Tracking Multimodal Clinical Trajectories for Inpatient Risk Prediction
papers.summary: TRACE organizes daily clinical events into temporal trajectories to improve inpatient risk prediction across mortality, length of stay, and readmission tasks.

papers.title: TokenGate: Adapting LLMs for Fast and Memory-Efficient Prefill with Learned Token Pruning
papers.summary: TokenGate is a lightweight learnable token-pruning module that accelerates long-context prefill in transformers by selectively skipping unimportant tokens via token-gated attention.

papers.title: Harness-Delta Attribution: Dissecting Gains From Harness Evolution
papers.summary: Harness-Delta Attribution dissects harness evolution gains into overfitting, test-time scaling, and residual generalizable improvement, finding that most search-set gains do not reliably transfer to held-out tasks.

papers.title: Vision as Proprioception: Estimating Humanoid Robot Pose from Video
papers.summary: HumanoidPose recovers full-body humanoid robot joint configurations from video by combining human-pose features with robot kinematics and self-training on unlabeled videos.

papers.title: A Language-Informed Loss for Visual Generation
papers.summary: LILIE uses an invertible normalizing-flow encoder to derive language-informed supervision for text-to-image generation, improving fidelity over pixel-only training.

papers.title: First Passage Attention
papers.summary: First Passage Attention replaces monotonic decay accumulation with path extrema to selectively retain older context, enabling perfect long-range retrieval with compressed caches.

papers.title: Competence-Based Evaluation of Logical Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.summary: Competence-based evaluation reveals that large language models fail to consistently apply reasoning rules across varied problem presentations despite high accuracy on bounded tasks.

papers.title: Legal Guidance in the Wild: How Users Seek Legal Help in Real-World LLM Conversations
papers.summary: The study develops a taxonomy to identify legal guidance requests in conversational AI, annotates thousands of chats, and evaluates ModernBERT models against a baseline for detecting such queries.

papers.title: Predicting Privileged Information Effectiveness for On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.summary: On-policy self-distillation with privileged information improves multi-turn agent performance depending on content and source, and KL-based metrics better predict training gains than direct utility estimates.

papers.title: Measuring Mechanistic Uncertainty in Large Language Models via Causal Robustness
papers.summary: Mechanistic uncertainty is quantified via internal mechanism stability using causal robustness margins and concept steering vectors, revealing that incorrect responses are more sensitive to interventions and that learned facts gain robustness.

papers.title: StopLoss: Teaching Agents to Predict Failure and Stop Early
papers.summary: StopLoss is a lightweight external monitor that predicts coding-agent failures from recent tool steps to abort doomed runs early, reducing compute costs while preserving successful outcomes.

papers.title: Heterogeneous Agentic Coevolution
papers.summary: HACE is a framework that jointly evolves specialized foundation models and LLM agents through reciprocal learning and evolutionary optimization of their interaction harness, improving performance across recommendation, protein prediction, and materials discovery.

papers.title: Any 3D Scene is Worth 1K Tokens: 3D-Grounded Representation for Scene Generation at Scale
papers.summary: Direct diffusion modeling in a 3D latent space improves spatial consistency and efficiency for scene-level 3D generation compared to 2D-based methods.

papers.title: Progress-Aware Distillation for Mitigating Stagnation in Small Language Model Agents
papers.summary: Progress-Aware Distillation detects and penalizes stagnation in distilled small language model agents to improve reasoning efficiency and success rates.
